sidesteps.whiff_notes: Chainsaw transitions (DES) aur linear flying dash moves (WR2) tracking lose kar jate hain.
Chaos Judgment (CJM) low/mid mixups aur rocket launcher approach linear hain.
Dark Upper (f,n,d,df+2) aur shoulder charges left side par asani se dodge hote hain.
b+3 (Parry/Cancels) aur wr3 approach SSR par whiff hoti hain.
wr3,2 ka pehla hit SSR par jata hai lekin doosra hit duck karna padta hai.
Spinner Ball roll aur cd+1 momentum seedha chalta hai; SSL se side-swish hota hai.
qcb+3 (Hatchet Kick), 3+4, aur f,b+2 (Jet Upper) dono SSR par clean whiff dete hain.
Starburst (STB) enhanced running moves (wr2) aur b+1 linear hain.
Phoenix Shift (PHX) sword lunges aur Eikonic magic dashes SSL par side-step hote hain.
EWGF, Hell Sweep (CD.4), aur flying lasers sab SSL par asani se dodge hote hain.
wr2 (Running 2), d+2, aur Sneak (SNK) entries SSL par cut ho jati hain.
Mandinga (MND) aur Handstand (HSP) circular spins SSR par catch hote hain.
Garuda kicks aur bf+4 Jet Kick linear hain; SSL se spacing break hoti hai.
b+1, db+3 (Low sweep), aur df+3 shoulder bashes SSR par easily dodge hote hain.
Electric Wind God Fist, Demon God Sword, aur b+4 homing move ke ilawa sab SSL par safe hain.
Hwoarang ki jis taraf pait ho (RFS/LFS stance ke mutabiq), us taraf step karein.
Gamma Howl (GMH) dash punches aur photonic beams linear hain.
f+4 (Eldritch/Knee), d+2, aur ff+2 Demon Paw SSR par whiff hote hain.
Izumo (IZU) stance pokes aur mists SSL par side-step ho jate hain.
EWGF, Hellsweep, aur ff+2 Demon Paw teeno left side par weak hain.
Jaguar Sprint (JGS) aur running approaches SSR par avoid hoti hain.
Bear hitboxes bade hain lekin rolling attacks aur salmon slaps SSL par cut hote hain.
Setsuna (SET) teleports aur kunai throws linear hain.
Dynamic (DEN) entry dashes aur f,b+2,1 SSL par completely whiff dete hain.
Dragon Charge (DSS) mixups aur slide (fc df+3) SSR par dodge hote hain.
Silver Tail aur Mist Step (MS) loops left side par asani se break hote hain.
KNK stance transitions aur b+1,4 strings SSL par cut ho jati hain.
Hermit (HRM) parry stances aur cane attacks SSR par bypass hote hain.
Heaven & Earth (HAE) stances aur horse lunges SSL par side-step hote hain.
Dew Glide (qcf) approaches aur Matterhorn (d+3+4) SSR par dodge hoti hain.
Mora (MOR) aur Baobab (BAO) wall climbs SSR par cut ho jati hain.
df+1, ss1 pressure, aur butterfly loops SSR par break hote hain.
Deathfist (qcf+2) aur Demoman (d+4:2:1+2) SSR par completely whiff dete hain.
Soulzone (SZ) clones aur teleport shadows SSL par catch hote hain.
Sentai (SEN) entries, ff+2, aur lightning pokes SSR par weak hain.
Animal Stance (ANM) leaps aur kangaroo punches linear hain.
Sneak (SNK) slide aur f,b+2 neck snap SSR par avoid hote hain.
Ducking (DCK) punches aur flicker (FLK) jabs SSL par dodge hote hain.
Iai (IAI) sword dashes aur Perfumer (PRF) teleports SSL par cut hote hain.
Art of Phoenix (AoP) ke dauran SSR aur low tracking active rakhni padti hai.
Flash (1+4) ke khilaf SSR, jabke b+2,2 ke khilaf SSL use karein.
Mantis (MNT) aur Scarecrow (SCR) low profiles SSR par catch hote hain.

throw_breaks.break_guide: Multi-part chain throw: Starts with 1 or 2 depending on limb.
Both hands slam into ground ➔ Break 1+2
Visual trick: Looks like 1+2, but is 1 Break! (70 Dmg).
Multi-part chain throws: Can branch into 1, 2, or 1+2 enders.

anti_cheese.why_players_lose: Chainsaws block par chip damage aur plus frames dete hain.
anti_cheese.pro_counter: Chainsaw stance transition ke waqt df+1 ya Dickjab (db+1) maarein—yeh Alisa ke chainsaws ko foran band (shut down) kar deta hai!

anti_cheese.why_players_lose: Log whiff samajh kar run karte hain aur second hit kha jate hain.
anti_cheese.pro_counter: b+3 block par -19 hai—long range f,f+2 ya EWGF se launch karein!

anti_cheese.why_players_lose: Bahut tezi se aata hai aur block par +2 hai.
anti_cheese.pro_counter: Pehla hit (wr3) block karke SSL + Duck karein ➔ ws2 se full launch!

anti_cheese.why_players_lose: Slow launching low aur safe-looking mid-mid string.
anti_cheese.pro_counter: df+3 (i29) ko reaction par crouch block (-26) karein. 1+2,2 block par -14 hai!

anti_cheese.why_players_lose: Fullscreen se mid sword lunge maarta hai.
anti_cheese.pro_counter: f+1+2 ka 2nd hit block par -13 se -14 hai. PHX dash ko SSL ya df+1 se float karein.

anti_cheese.why_players_lose: Beginner Eddy players sirf 3 button mash karte rehte hain.
anti_cheese.pro_counter: Doosri kick ke baad string Low jati hai ➔ Low Parry (df) ya RLX transition mein low-hitting mid (df+4 / d+2) maarein.

anti_cheese.why_players_lose: Hwoarang ka sabse bada pressure starter (+8 on hit).
anti_cheese.pro_counter: Agar aap d+3 hit bhi kha jayein, tab bhi 2nd hit (4) High hai—agar aap pehle se crouch mein hain toh woh whiff hoga, warna block par RFS mein Dickjab (db+1) maarein!

anti_cheese.why_players_lose: 2,1,4 safe mid-high-mid poke hai.
anti_cheese.pro_counter: 2,1,4 ke 3rd hit ko delay hone par SSR karein. d+2 (i22 High-Crush Low) ki red flash dekh kar crouch block karein (-14 WS punish!).

anti_cheese.why_players_lose: 1,2,4 low kick hai jis ke baad 3 mid aata hai.
anti_cheese.pro_counter: 1,2 dekhte hi df (Low Parry) hold kar lein—3rd hit (4) auto low-parry ho jayega!

anti_cheese.why_players_lose: Low kicks ki series jo counter-hit par combo deti hai.
anti_cheese.pro_counter: Pehli kick khane ke foran baad df (Low Parry) hold karein ya block karke ws Launch (-15 to -25) karein!

anti_cheese.why_players_lose: Mid-Low-Mid string jo launcher deti hai.
anti_cheese.pro_counter: b+2 (Mid palm) dekhte hi df (Low Parry) hold karein—2nd hit (3 low) har baar parry hoga! d+2,3 block par -15 Launch hai!

anti_cheese.why_players_lose: High aur mid تک ko crush karke launch kar deti hai.
anti_cheese.pro_counter: Matterhorn block par -21 hai! Hamesha sabse bada launcher maarein.

anti_cheese.why_players_lose: Deewar par chadh kar diving mixup lagati hai.
anti_cheese.pro_counter: 1,2,2 ka 3rd hit block par -12 hai. BAO wall hang ke khilaf Sidestep Right (SSR) karein!

anti_cheese.why_players_lose: Low-High poke aur High-Low-High string.
anti_cheese.pro_counter: d+4,1 aur uf+4,3,4 ka 2nd hit low aur last hit High hai—crouch hold rakhein aur ws Launch karein!

anti_cheese.why_players_lose: Close range knockdown low aur backsway high kick.
anti_cheese.pro_counter: Demoman sirf point-blank range (0.5) par clean hit karta hai—backdash (KBD) rakhein. df+1~b, 4 High hai—duck & launch!

anti_cheese.why_players_lose: Reina ff+2 block par bhi SEN stance mein chali jati hai.
anti_cheese.pro_counter: Agar Reina ff+2 Block par SEN mein jaye, toh aap df+1 ya Jab (1) se uske har option (SEN.3 ke ilawa) ko interrupt/float kar sakte hain!

anti_cheese.why_players_lose: b+1 mashers ko launch karta hai; d+2,1,2 safe lagta hai.
anti_cheese.pro_counter: Steve ke saamne high attacks mat mash karein (High Crush moves use karein). d+2,1 ke baad Steve duck cancel karta hai—wahan df+1 se check karein.

anti_cheese.why_players_lose: 2,2,2 teleport karke mixup deta hai; u+1+2 fullscreen explosion hai.
anti_cheese.pro_counter: 2,2,2 mein Gun Shot (3rd hit) High hai ➔ Duck the Gun Shot & Launch! u+1+2 (Expulsion) block par -20 (Launch Punishable) hai!

anti_cheese.why_players_lose: Mids tak ke neeche se nikal jati hai.
anti_cheese.pro_counter: Apne character ka Low-Hitting Mid (jaise Kazuya df+2 / ff+4, Jin d+4 / df+1, Bryan qcb+3 / d+2) yaad rakhein jo AoP ko hit karta hai!

anti_cheese.why_players_lose: Aapke plus frames mein bhi Flash maar kar combo le jata hai.
anti_cheese.pro_counter: Plus frames lene ke baad 1 second rukein (Bait the Flash!)—Flash whiff hone par -15 से -20 Launch Punishable hai!

heat_smashes.danger_and_counter: Jack-8 ka Heat Smash i10 punisher hai! Jack Heat mein ho toh -10 move kabhi na karein. Block par Jack ka Heat Smash -9 (Safe) hai.

heat_smashes.characters: Kazuya, Eddy, Paul, Lee, Claudio, Jin (ZEN.2+3)
heat_smashes.danger_and_counter: Yeh Heat Smashes Low hain! Agar aap stand block karenge toh hit ho jayenge. Inke khilaf crouch block karein—block hone par yeh -14 se -15 (Launch Punishable) hote hain!

heat_smashes.characters: Jun (i13 Fullscreen Beam), Victor, Clive, Devil Jin (Psyche Laser), Alisa
heat_smashes.danger_and_counter: Fullscreen par whiff karne ki ghalti na karein! Jun aur Clive ka Heat Smash screen ke doosre kone se whiff punish karta hai aur Jun ki Health bhi heal karta hai.

heat_smashes.characters: Reina (HW), Miary Zo (+6 BAO), Lidia (HAE), Law (DSS), Lars (DEN), Azucena (LIB), Hwoarang (RFS)
heat_smashes.danger_and_counter: Inka Heat Smash block karne ke baad kabhi button na dabayein! Yeh block par +6 se +10 hote hain aur automatic Stance 50/50 mein chale jate hain.

heat_smashes.category: Throw / Unblockable Floor Break Heat Smashes
heat_smashes.characters: King (+10 into Jaguar Sprint), Dragunov, Heihachi (Wall Splat)
heat_smashes.danger_and_counter: King ka Heat Smash sabse zyada raw damage deta hai aur block hone par woh सीधा Jaguar Sprint (JGS) mein aata hai jahan se Unbreakable Throw lag sakta hai—us waqt Sidestep Right (SSR) ya jab float karein!

movement_bible.why: Cancels normal backdash recovery pause using d/b (crouch cancel) to maintain safe guard while retreating across the stage.
movement_bible.input: b, B -> slide to db -> release to b -> n -> b -> slide to db -> b... (Rhythm: b, b, [db, b, n, b])
movement_bible.warning: Backsway characters (Bryan, Paul, Nina, Steve, Lee) must use clean b ~ db ~ b inputs. Never use qcb method or backsway will trigger and get you launched!

movement_bible.why: Rapidly close distance, realign tracking against opponent sidesteps, and impose lethal 50/50 mixups (Hell Sweep vs Mid launcher).
movement_bible.input: f, n, d, df -> slide to f (cancels Crouch Dash into forward dash) -> n, d, df, f...
movement_bible.trick: Wavedash into Block (CD~B): Suddenly hold Back during wavedash to bait nervous keepout whiffs and launch them.

movement_bible.why: Stand up from crouching in 1 frame to perform powerful standing launchers (like EWGF or f,b+2) after blocking low attacks.
movement_bible.input: Tap Up (u, n) or tap Forward (f, n) from crouch -> execute standing launcher.

movement_bible.why: Perform point-blank (0 range) running attacks (e.g. Dragunov wr2, Claudio wr2, Azucena wr3,2, King Shining Wizard fff+2+4).
movement_bible.input: f, n, f, F + Button (rapid forward triple tap).

movement_bible.technique: Defensive Option-Select: Sidestep to Guard (SS ~ B / SS ~ db)
movement_bible.why: Evade linear attacks while preventing homing attacks or delayed strings from catching you during step recovery.
movement_bible.input: Tap Up or Down to Sidestep -> immediately hold Back (B) or Down-Back (db) after 6 frames.

controllers.pros: Arslan Ash, Atif Butt, Farzeen, Lil Majin, Anakin
controllers.technique: Claw Grip (index and middle fingers over 1,2,3,4 face buttons) enables instantaneous 1+4, 2+3, and multi-throw breaks.
Korean Lever (Crown 309MJ / Knee Lever) rubber grommet snaps lever back to Neutral in 1ms for effortless KBD and Wavedash.
SOCD Cleaning allows holding Back while tapping Down-Forward for lightning-fast 1-button KBD and consistent 13f PEWGF.

zero_lag_settings.reason: Reduces network input delay. Do not use 'Prioritize Smoothness' as it introduces 2-3 frames of artificial lag.
V-Sync ON adds ~35ms (2+ frames) of display lag, making 20f throw breaks and low reactions nearly impossible.
Ensures rock-solid 60.0 FPS locks on heavy particle stages like Yakushima and Ortiz Farm.
Default sparks obscure opponent arm/shoulder startup animations, preventing accurate visual throw breaks.

blender_emergency_protocol.detail: 90% of strings in Tekken 8 that end in a mid attack are minus on block (-3 to -14). Once you block a mid, stop defending and take your turn with a 10f jab or 13f mid poke!
i10 Special Mid that crushes all high attacks and interrupts string transitions. The ultimate panic button against oppressive stance mashers.
Fast unreactable low kick that ducks under highs and checks opponents standing up.
i16 Power Crush armor active on frame 7. Absorbs all incoming mids and highs to instantly reclaim offensive momentum.
